free_tier.notes: Absence of a readable page is the finding, not a gap in the search.

interface_detail: Nothing reachable to describe. LinksVIP and Getlink.vn both still name 'Ten lua' in titles and host lists.
tooling: none that still works: the get-link shops that named it are the remaining pointer, and LinksVIP's own premium page header still carries the name.

reliability_note: Third-party uptime tracking reports the domain down across 638 days of checks; a direct read through the broker returned a gateway error that the broker itself attributes to the broker, so it proves nothing about the target.
confidence_note: Death rests on a third-party status page plus the absence of any live page, not on a measurement of ours. Two routes were tried: broker read (broker-side 504, no evidence) and a Wayback lookup at 2023-06 (nearest capture 2023-04-25, no content check made). A 2026 archive read would move this to documented.

evidence.proved: 'Status: down', 'Response Code: -', '13 operability checks occurred for tenlua.vn within the time frame of 638 days after November 20'
broker read returned 'broker-side failure (HTTP 504); nothing established about the target' - recorded so the failed route is not mistaken for the death evidence

notes: Third of the three Vietnamese hosts the get-link economy was built on (Fshare, 4share, Tenlua). Recorded dead rather than deleted so the next session does not spend a wave re-finding it. Abandonment condition: a 2026 Wayback capture or a live response showing a working storefront.
